note: Cable zones for the brochure: top five products per zone (typical; confirm with Southwire product management) and the model location of each, projected into the zone's hero camera.

zones.name: Grid connection
zones.intro: The plant's output leaves through step-up transformers and a breaker-and-a-half 230 kV switchyard. Where the circuits run underground, HV cable rises to outdoor terminations; overhead conductor carries them to the grid.
products: HV XLPE transmission cable, 230 kV
Underground circuits from the step-up transformers and the CCS and modular-yard ties: Cu conductor, XLPE, metallic moisture barrier, HDPE jacket.
Overhead conductor (ACSR / ACSS)
The 230 kV lines leaving the terminal towers, and the switchyard bus jumpers.
Bare copper grounding conductor
The station ground grid, rods and risers under the yard and every structure.
Type TC-ER control cable, shielded
Breaker, CT / VT and relay circuits in the yard trenches to the relay house.
MV-105 shielded power cable
15-35 kV station-service and auxiliary feeders at the yard edge.

zones.name: Power island
zones.intro: Three H-class gas turbines and a steam turbine share one hall. Every auxiliary that keeps them turning, from lube oil to fuel valves to the static starters, is fed and controlled by cable.
products: ARMOR-X® MC-HL 15 kV, red PVC
13.8 kV feeders to auxiliary drives through the Class I, Div. 2 turbine areas, laid in tray with no conduit.
ARMOR-X® MC-HL 600 V, black PVC
Motor and power circuits on the turbine enclosures, lube-oil and fuel skids.
Switchgear to unit transformers, boiler feed pumps and the static starters.
VFD cable, symmetrical grounds, shielded
Drives to pumps and fans: controls noise and reflected-wave stress.
Instrumentation cable (PLTC / ITC)
Turbine and HRSG control loops, transmitters and thermocouples.

zones.name: Balance of plant
zones.intro: Around the power island, the balance of plant keeps it running. Here, the inlet-chilling plant: six water-cooled chillers, cooling-water pumps, an e-house and a 12-cell tower, all fed, controlled and protected by cable.
products: MV-105 5 kV and 15 kV
13.8 and 4.16 kV feeders to the chiller compressors, cooling-water pumps and station transformers.
Type TC-ER 600 V power
Motor-control-center and panel feeders out of the e-house and across the racks.
SIMpull® THHN / XHHW-2 building wire
Lighting, receptacles and HVAC in the chiller, water-treatment, control and admin buildings.
Type TC-ER control, multiconductor
Pump, valve and level interlocks between the e-house and the process.
Fire alarm and life-safety cable
Detection and notification circuits in the plant buildings and e-houses.

zones.name: Carbon capture
zones.intro: Post-combustion capture adds a second plant's worth of motors: 16 MW booster fans, quench and solvent pumps, compressors, all fed from the CCS rack.
products: MV-105 15 kV
Feeders to the 16 MW booster fans and the CO2 compressors.
ARMOR-X® MC-HL 15 kV
MV circuits along the carbon-capture rack.
ARMOR-X® MC-HL 600 V
Pump, blower and actuator power in the amine process area.
VFD cable
Variable-speed drives on quench and solvent pumps.
Instrumentation cable (PLTC / ITC)
Cooler, absorber, stripper and regeneration control loops.

zones.name: Fuel
zones.sub: Gas yard, M&R station, LNG and hydrogen
zones.intro: Gas arrives at the metering and regulating station and is filtered, heated and regulated in the plant gas yard: hazardous areas where every circuit is built for them.
products: ARMOR-X® MC-HL 600 V
Power in the Class I areas: regulation and heating skids, vaporizers, electrolyzers.
Type TC-ER-HL power and control
Hazardous-location circuits where armor is not required.
Armored instrumentation cable
Metering, pressure and gas-detection loops.
Fuel-gas compressor and boil-off compressor motors.
Bare copper grounding and bonding
Static and lightning protection at skids, tanks and unloading arms.

zones.name: Battery storage
zones.intro: The battery yard pairs containers with power-conversion skids. DC conductors run in precast trenches; 35 kV collection loops carry the power to the yard substation.
products: PV / RHW-2 2 kV DC conductor
Battery racks to inverters in precast trenches (1,500 V systems).
MV-105 35 kV aluminium, concentric neutral
Collection loops from the PCS / MV skids to the collector e-house.
Type TC-ER 600 V
Container HVAC, auxiliary power and the energy management system.
Shielded control / communications cable
Battery management, inverter and SCADA links.
Bare copper grounding
Container and skid grounding to the yard grid.

zones.name: Modular and temporary power
zones.intro: Containerized gensets, trailer turbines and bridge-power fleets come and go. Their cable lies on the pad, crosses lanes under drive-over protectors and plugs in with cam-locks.
products: Type SHD-GC portable power cable, 15 kV
MV feeders from gensets and trailer units, laid on the pad and under drive-over protectors.
Type W portable power cable, 2 kV
480 V single conductors with cam-lock connections.
MV-105 15 kV in ground trays
Bridge-power feeders and TM2500 generator leads to the duct bank.
Type G-GC portable cable
Multi-conductor portable links for smaller gensets and load banks.
Type TC-ER control
Genset paralleling, protection and fuel-skid control.
